newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim to build GSM phone base stations.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim to build GSM phone base stations.

text.p: Polish trader Elektrim SA signed on October 28 an agreement with the GSM digital phone operator Era GSM to build masts, towers and supports for Era's cellular phone base stations, Elektrim said in a statement on Tuesday.
PTC Era GSM SA, one of the two companies that obtained licenses for digital cellular phones in Poland, launched services in September.
Elektrim is one of Era's major shoreholders with a 32.5 percent stake. Other shareholders include U S West Inc and Deutsche Telekom's subsidiary DeTeMobil, with 22.5 percent stakes each.
